scripts.build: npm run clean && npm run build:packages && npm run build:apps
scripts.build:packages: npm run -w @rta/shared build && npm run -w @rta/game-engine build && npm run -w @rta/database prisma:generate && npm run -w @rta/database build && npm run -w @rta/auth build && npm run -w @rta/services build
scripts.build:apps: npm run -w @rta/api build && npm run -w @rta/bot build && npm run -w @rta/worker build && npm run -w @rta/web build
scripts.dev: npm run build:packages && concurrently -k -n api,bot,worker,web "npm run -w @rta/api dev" "npm run -w @rta/bot dev" "npm run -w @rta/worker dev" "npm run -w @rta/web dev"
scripts.lint: npm run build:packages && npm run lint:workspaces
scripts.check: npm run security:secrets && npm run lint && npm test && npm run prisma:validate && npm run validate:context && npm run build && npm audit --audit-level=high
